title: Sparse Bayesian Neural Networks via Sticky Piecewise Deterministic Markov Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.32753v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: There is growing evidence that the performance of a neural network depends largely on a small subset of its weights, which are typically identified by training a dense network and pruning it afterwards. Within a Bayesian framework, pruning can be directly incorporated through a spike-and-slab prior, providing a proper treatment of the uncertainties involved, both with respect to pruning and to parameter uncertainty. In Bayesian neural networks (BNNs), sampling by MCMC is notoriously hard. We demonstrate that modern Monte Carlo methods based on piecewise deterministic Markov processes (PDMPs) can be used to sample posteriors of BNNs asymptotically exact whenever numerically constructed rate bounds hold. Spike-and-slab priors can be incorporated through sticky versions of the PDMPs, setting weights exactly to zero during sampling. translated_title: 基于粘性分段确定性马尔可夫过程的稀疏贝叶斯神经网络
translated_abstract: 越来越多的证据表明，神经网络的性能在很大程度上取决于其权重中的一小部分，这些权重通常通过训练一个密集网络然后进行剪枝来识别。在贝叶斯框架内，剪枝可以通过尖峰-平板先验直接纳入，从而对所涉及的不确定性进行恰当处理，包括剪枝不确定性和参数不确定性。在贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）中，通过MCMC进行采样是出了名的困难。我们证明了基于分段确定性马尔可夫过程（PDMP）的现代蒙特卡洛方法，只要数值构造的速率界成立，就可以渐近精确地采样BNN的后验分布。尖峰-平板先验可以通过粘性版本的PDMP纳入，在采样过程中将权重精确地设置为零。我们检验了这些采样器的预测性能和收敛性，并表明以这种方式采样的稀疏BNN…
tldr: 该论文提出利用粘性分段确定性马尔可夫过程结合尖峰-平板先验，在贝叶斯神经网络的采样过程中将权重精确置零，实现渐近精确的稀疏贝叶斯神经网络采样与剪枝。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using sticky piecewise deterministic Markov processes (PDMPs) with spike-and-slab priors to set weights exactly to zero during sampling, enabling asymptotically exact sparse Bayesian neural network sampling and pruning.
